EQ_G50_90.alpha_kind: uniform 2-D field matched to paired gate diagnostic snow mass

EQ_G75_95.alpha_kind: uniform 2-D field matched to paired gate diagnostic snow mass

EQ_G90_99.alpha_kind: uniform 2-D field matched to paired gate diagnostic snow mass

GATE_G50_90.alpha_kind: 2-D horizontal gate field applied at every mass level

GATE_G75_95.alpha_kind: 2-D horizontal gate field applied at every mass level

GATE_G90_99.alpha_kind: 2-D horizontal gate field applied at every mass level

interpretation_limits: Same-event diagnostic; no independent forecast-skill claim.
Gate and equal-mass fields alter only initial QSNOW; equal initial dry-mass-weighted QSNOW does not establish water, energy, or initialization conservation.
Crossed executable/input cases are a 2×2 diagnostic and do not isolate a single physical process.
Scoring uses total precipitation, not snowfall alone.

observed_intensity_bins.aggregation: point counts only; no means across bins, thresholds, leads, or cases
observed_intensity_bins.scope: diagnostic counts on all 3,688 paired verification points; no input gate or eligibility mask

pointwise_difference: hourly total precipitation minus ORIGINAL on same RN1 point keys
rmse_ranking_scope: lead-1 RMSE; frozen in the pre-output selection plan
transition_scope: per-point flags and counts versus ORIGINAL at each lead and threshold

winner.admission: all 18 weak cells CSI >= ORIGINAL and strict lead-1 CSI@10 > ORIGINAL; zero tolerance
winner.averaging: No aggregation across thresholds, leads, or experiments.
winner.constraints: weak thresholds 0.1/0.5/1.0 mm at each lead 1-6, plus lead-1 10.0 mm CSI
winner.weak_threshold_interpretation: These CSI floors include hits at all observed intensities above each cutoff, including heavy-rain hits; they are not light-rain-only scores.
